description: Ministry of  Mahaweli Development and Environment - Order to prohibit the manufacture of Polythene or any Polythene product, 20 microns and below
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory instrument issued under the National Environmental Act, No. 47 of 1980. It contains a prohibition order on the manufacture and sale of certain polythene products, which constitutes regulatory action. The content involves the creation of new regulations (prohibitions and exceptions) under existing legislation, making it a clear example of legal/regulatory matter rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
